chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

That Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) was brought to him a man who had hired a man to repair his door, and he struck the door of his house, and he struck the nail and the door cracked, so Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) held him liable.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic legal ruling on liability for damage caused by a hired worker?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) citing Imam Ali (AS) establishes the foundational principle of 'daman' (liability) in employment contracts, emphasizing that the worker bears responsibility for damage caused during the execution of their task. This ruling underscores the concept of 'amanah' (trust) in professional duties, where the hired hand is accountable for negligence or mishandling of the employer's property, a key precedent in Shia fiqh for civil liabilities.
